issues.detail: The Greek 'ιεροσολυμα' (Jerusalem) refers to the city/people of Jerusalem as a collective entity, but the Vietnamese 'dân thành Giê-ru-sa-lem' adds 'dân' (people), which is not in the text. More importantly, the Greek verb 'εξεπορευετο' implies a 'coming out' or 'gathering forth' toward him, whereas 'đến cùng người' (came to him) misses the nuance of the movement/gathering.
